run_segmentation_evaluation: run evaluate_segmentation_model to compute mIoU, dice, and fscore metrics on a test dataloader
test_segmentation_pipeline: test a DINOv3 segmentation model end-to-end by building the decoder, dataloader, and running inference
build_segmentation_decoder: build a segmentation decoder from a backbone using build_segmentation_decoder with M2F head configuration
load_dinov3_vit7b16_ms: load the DINOv3 ViT-7B-16 segmentation model with M2F adapter via torch hub
calculate_segmentation_metrics: calculate mIoU, dice, and fscore segmentation metrics from intersect and union tensors
